title: prunus zhengheensis
intro: Prunus zhengheensis, commonly known as the Zhenghe Cherry Plum, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is primarily known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Prunus zhengheensis include its potential to protect against cell damage and its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
